t: You're looking at the Rifle Brigade War Memorial, near Victoria Station in Westminster, at the junction of Grosvenor Gardens and Hobart Place. It commemorates the service of the Rifle Brigade in the First and Second World Wars. The land was donated by the 2nd Duke of Westminster. The sculptor was John Tweed, a Scottish artist, who made the memorial. Take a moment to look at the figures and read the names and inscriptions as you stand here.
